tasks.short: She trains and supervises curatorial staff, volunteers and interns.

steps.what: Train and supervise curatorial, fiscal, technical, research, and clerical staff, volunteers or interns.
inputs: the work in front of each person this week

tasks.design: She still trains and supervises curatorial, fiscal, technical, research and clerical staff, and volunteers or interns, in the room with the work. No course record is part of this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each person needs direction on the object and the task in front of them, and that changes with the week.
tasks.enabler_now: Catalogue drafts, handwriting recognition and scheduled notices are other tasks in this group. Directing staff stays manual, and this task is that direction.
tasks.still_hard: A volunteer who has not handled the object, and a week whose priorities have just changed.
tasks.human_edge: She sees who is unsure with the object and what to correct on the spot.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still trains and supervises these people. She gains no right to leave them without that direction.

reach.task: Take direction on the object in hand
reach.learn: Which correction she gives on the object, and which one can wait

evidence.claim: Training and supervising staff, volunteers and interns is in-person direction. A course completion record is a different task.

assumptions: The training and the supervision are the whole task. No course record is part of this statement.
Catalogue drafts and scheduled notices are other tasks, so none of that time sits here.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The direction keeps its full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a senior technician already supervises the volunteers on some days.
research_questions: Which corrections does she still have to give in the room?

already_counted.description: She still trains and supervises the staff, volunteers and interns.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still trains and supervises in person. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She confers with the board on policy, budget and operations.

steps.what: Confer with the board of directors to formulate and interpret policies
inputs: the collection question in front of the board

steps.what: determine budget requirements and plan overall operations

tasks.design: She still confers with the board to formulate and interpret policies, and in that same meeting she determines budget requirements and plans overall operations. No policy paper is written as a separate step of this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The board decision depends on what she says in the room about the collection, the money and the year's operations.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafted grant text and policy documents are other tasks in this group. This task is the board conference, and it stays.
tasks.still_hard: A budget figure the board will not accept, and an operations plan that conflicts with a loan already promised.
tasks.human_edge: She can say which policy the collection can live with and which budget line is real.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still confers with the board. She gains no right to set policy or a budget without that conference.

reach.task: Explain a policy choice to a board
reach.learn: Which budget line she will defend, and which one she will drop

evidence.claim: Formulating policy and setting a budget with a board is a live conference. A later policy document is a different task.

assumptions: The conference is the whole task. Formulating policy and planning operations happen in that meeting.
A later written policy is another task, so none of that time sits here.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
Both parts keep their full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a director already brings the budget figure so she only interprets policy.
research_questions: Which budget lines does she still have to argue in the room?

already_counted.description: She still confers on policy and still sets the budget and operations plan with the board.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still confers with the board. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She arranges insurance for loans and exhibits and recommends coverage.

steps.what: Arrange insurance coverage for objects on loan or for special exhibits
inputs: objects going on loan or into the exhibit
outputs: coverage arranged for that loan or exhibit

steps.what: recommend changes in coverage for the entire collection

tasks.design: She still arranges insurance coverage by talking with the insurer about objects on loan or in a special exhibit, and she still recommends changes in coverage for the entire collection. The loan file already names the objects. She does not type them again inside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The coverage depends on the object, the loan terms and the risk she judges in the conversation with the insurer.
tasks.enabler_now: Catalogue records and condition reports are other tasks. This task is the coverage talk and the recommendation, and both stay with her.
tasks.still_hard: A lender who wants a higher value than the object will support, and a collection-wide change the insurer will not take.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which object the loan actually puts at risk and which coverage change is worth asking for.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still arranges the coverage and still makes the recommendation. She gains no right to bind the museum to a coverage change she has not judged.

reach.task: Name the objects in a loan
reach.learn: Which object she treats as the risk, and which value she will not accept

evidence.claim: Arranging loan or exhibit coverage is a talk with the insurer, and the collection-wide recommendation is her judgement. A registrar's object list is a different task.

assumptions: The loan file already names the objects. Retyping that file is not a step she does in this task.
A registrar who already sends the object list is another role, so that time is not hers here.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The insurer talk and the recommendation keep their full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a registrar already arranges the insurer talk so she only recommends the change.
research_questions: Which coverage decisions does she still have to make on the call?

already_counted.description: She still arranges loan and exhibit coverage and still recommends collection-wide changes.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still talks to the insurer and still recommends the coverage change. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She schedules events and organizes refreshment, entertainment, decorations and fees.

steps.what: Schedule events and organize details, including refreshment, entertainment and decorations
inputs: the public event she is planning

tasks.design: She still schedules the event and organizes refreshment, entertainment and decorations in the conversations that set the plan, and she still organizes how any fees are collected. A purchase order or a ticket sale placed by another role is not this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The date, the refreshment, the entertainment, the decorations and the fees are choices she makes for this event, and they change with the audience.
tasks.enabler_now: Notices, catalogue drafts and programme text are other tasks. The digest keeps public programmes manual. This task is the scheduling and the organizing, and both stay.
tasks.still_hard: A performer who cancels, and a fee the front desk cannot take on the day.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which detail the event can drop and which fee the audience will actually pay.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still schedules the event and organizes the details and the fees. She gains no right to let a notice stand in for those choices.

reach.learn: Which detail she settles in the planning conversation, and which fee she leaves to the desk

evidence.claim: Scheduling a public programme and organizing refreshment, entertainment, decorations and fees is her coordination. A later purchase order is a different role.

assumptions: She organizes refreshment, entertainment, decorations and fees in the same conversations as the schedule. No second supplier entry is part of this task.
A purchase order or ticket sale placed by another role is not her time here.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
Both parts keep their full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether an events officer already schedules the day so she only chooses the programme.
research_questions: Which event details does she still settle herself?

already_counted.description: She still schedules the event and still organizes refreshment, entertainment, decorations and fees.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still schedules the event and organizes the details and the fees. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Nothing in these tasks leaves her. Training staff, the board conference, insurance recommendations, and event logistics stay her week. She gains no right to skip supervision or to bind coverage she has not judged.
skills_to_grow: Train curatorial, fiscal, technical, research and clerical staff on the object in front of them, including volunteers and interns.
Take a budget figure to the board only after she can say what the collection needs.
Recommend a coverage change from the object and the loan, not from a figure she has not judged.
Schedule the event and name the refreshment, entertainment, decorations and fees herself.
role.ambitious_version: She still trains the staff, still confers with the board on policy, budget and operations, still arranges insurance and recommends coverage, and still schedules the event and organizes fees. She does not gain a right to let a notice stand in for supervision or for a coverage recommendation.
